primary_object_card.object_statement: Independent source-native manifold layer legos are built, audited, repaired, killed, or blocked before any stacking, post-stack, Axis0, flux, FEP, physics, or final-manifold continuation controls the formal sim campaign.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The campaign goal is to make the layer legos before stacking them and to keep continuing after each pass.
Build foundational legos as independent pure-math sims; only after relevant parent legos are current allow bounded stacking/composition tests.
A small sim counts as a real lego only if it declares its finite map, carrier, geometry, tools, negatives, promotion status, and consumer boundaries.
Layer legos that invoke shell, Axis0, FEP, gravity, flux, or future-possibility language must preserve the literal shell possibility-gradient rather than generic entropy or labels.
Axis0 is the shell-polarity readout of the possibility field; future shells compress inward, past shells record outward, and Phi0 must not collapse A0_raw prematurely.
The sim must instantiate the retrocausal possibility-constraint object first, then derive entropy, PEPS3D, QIT, FEP, and Axis0-like readouts from it.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The object to preserve is the active build process itself: a factory campaign that produces independent, source-native manifold layer legos before any stack, post-stack, Axis0, flux, FEP, physics, or final-manifold lane can control priority. Existing compact receipts are useful, but they do not end the layer-depth and variant campaign. M_RPF, v4.3 shell fields, source-native spinor/PEPS3D requirements, and Wolfram-style tools may be used only when they strengthen one bounded layer lego without replacing this priority order.

native_terms.layer lego: A bounded formal scout for one named manifold layer or variant, with finite map, domain, codomain, PEPS3D anchor, spinor or spinor-derived density, controls, tool depth, and blocked consumers.
native_terms.layer factory: The campaign that keeps selecting, building, auditing, repairing, killing, or blocking independent layer legos until all required layer-depth and variant rows are accounted for.
native_terms.compact finite-scope receipt: A passing local receipt for one layer row at bounded scale; useful evidence but not final layer-depth, variant, stacking, or manifold completion.
native_terms.post-stack: Any cross-row, bond-escalation, integrated stress, or stack-order continuation; allowed only after layer-depth/variant prerequisites are exhausted or as an explicitly demoted exploratory exception.
native_terms.M_RPF salvage: Retrocausal shell-field fields and controls reused inside per-layer legos when shell/future-possibility claims are made, not a priority override.
native_terms.literal shell possibility-gradient: The native shell object: Sigma_r(x), i/r shell order, Omega_r(x), j/k future-fuzz indices, future-inward compression, past-outward record, rho_Br, rho_IrBr, and compatibility weights.
native_terms.A0_raw: The pre-scalar Axis0 candidate vector: Delta H_Omega, Delta S_B, Delta K, order_gap, and chirality_sheet. Phi0 may project this vector later, but the layer factory must not assume that projection.
native_terms.Xi_shell: A downstream bridge from shell geometry/history into rho_IrBr or rho_AB that must preserve shell radius, orientation, Omega_r, boundary bookkeeping, noncommuting paths, spinor/chirality carrier, and readout provenance.

weirdness_signature: the build process is the object to preserve, not the latest interesting continuation artifact
parallelism is for breadth across independent layer/tool packets, not permission to widen into stacking
M_RPF and Wizard v4.3 are anti-drift guards and per-layer field requirements, not automatic proof that post-stack is next
existing passing compact receipts can coexist with an unfinished layer-depth and variant campaign
primary_object_card.domain: formal layer campaign artifacts, L0-L8 scout sources/results/ledgers, depth/variant packets, v4.3 object packets, source-native runtime constraints, and current continuation artifacts
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: a repaired active goal, layer-depth/variant matrix, next independent layer packet or blocker, and demoted/salvaged downstream continuation records
allowed_operations: validate existing compact L0-L8 receipts without treating them as terminal
select the next independent per-layer depth or variant packet
run v4.3 object preservation on the layer factory goal and on any layer-local RPF claim
salvage M_RPF, source-native, and Wolfram additions into layer-local controls or tool functions
write blockers for post-stack or downstream continuations when layer prerequisites are not exhausted
update matrix and continuation artifacts after every pass, fail, or blocker
required_invariants: layer-lego-first priority survives every continuation update
post-stack and downstream consumers remain locked until layer-depth/variant prerequisites are exhausted
compact finite-scope receipts are not final layer or manifold completion
M_RPF shell fields are layer-local unless a later admitted stacking packet is explicitly opened
literal shell possibility-gradient is preserved whenever shell, Axis0, FEP, gravity, flux, or future-possibility language is used
Axis0 remains downstream of A0_raw and Xi_shell; it cannot be a scalar entropy, I_c, logZ, or label-only proxy
FEP/Holodeck is local prediction-evidence-posterior compression derived from the shell object, not an imported metaphor
Wolfram, FEP, Axis0, entropy, and PEPS3D labels remain adapters, probes, analogies, or readouts unless tied to a layer-local finite map and controls
forbidden_substitutions: bond5 or bond6 admission as layer factory progress
M_RPF stack receipt as layer-depth completion
generic entropy gradient as shell possibility-gradient
cut bookkeeping without literal shell orientation
I_c, logZ, or logZ plus I_c as Axis0 by definition
FEP local update math before shell possibility field
gravity as a later physics overlay after generic entropy
scalar entropy label as layer proof
PEPS3D label without source-native spinor carrier
negative_controls: next step is post-stack before layer matrix exhausted
next step is bond/Wolfram before layer matrix exhausted
source-native spinor/PEPS3D requirements only recited, not load-bearing
M_RPF field lacks layer-local finite map
Omega_r scrambled while counts are preserved
scalar entropy still passes after shell direction is removed
tool import has no ablation outcome delta
downstream consumer unlocked by prose rather than receipt
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: M_RPF, Wolfram, FEP/Holodeck, Axis0, entropy, and PEPS3D can support the layer factory only as typed adapters, probes, analogies, or readouts with preservation/loss/precondition/kill-control fields. They cannot become the active priority while layer-depth and variant rows remain unmet.
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: system_v5/ops and system_v5/ops/formal_scouts layer-lego factory goal, matrix, receipts, and continuation artifacts

lateral_mappings.label: Wizard v4.3 RPF object card
lateral_mappings.target: per-layer shell-field preservation when a layer claims shell or future-possibility structure
preconditions: layer factory matrix still controls next row selection
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If RPF object preservation selects post-stack while layer-depth variants remain unmet, demote the move and select the next layer packet.

lateral_mappings.label: Source-native spinor PEPS3D runtime constraints
lateral_mappings.target: each layer lego's carrier and readout quality
preserves: Hopf fiber/base and L/R Weyl sign where applicable
loses: claim if used only as labels without carrier action
preconditions: torch-native carrier or explicit resource blocker
lateral_mappings.kill_control: Erase spinor phase, Hopf fiber/base, L/R sheet, or PEPS3D anchor; the layer claim must fail or weaken.

lateral_mappings.label: Literal shell possibility-gradient
lateral_mappings.target: per-layer native object preservation when shell, future possibility, Axis0, FEP, gravity, or flux language appears
preserves: Sigma_r shell stack and i/r shell order
Omega_r future-possibility set with j/k fuzz indices
future-inward compression and past-outward record orientation
rho_Br and rho_IrBr boundary/interior state provenance
A0_raw vector before any Phi0 scalar projection
loses: permission to promote Axis0, FEP, flux, gravity, or final manifold
preconditions: negative controls for erased shell direction, scrambled Omega_r, scalar entropy primary, and dense closure
lateral_mappings.kill_control: Erase radius/orientation/Omega_r while preserving scalar entropy; any Axis0, FEP, gravity, flux, or shell claim must fail, weaken, or be demoted to entropy diagnostic.

lateral_mappings.label: Wolfram multiway machinery
lateral_mappings.target: candidate branch generation or hypergraph stress inside one layer
preconditions: must be scoped to one layer packet
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If Wolfram machinery becomes the primary object or next campaign priority, reject the prompt.

lateral_mappings.label: Post-stack and bond escalation receipts
lateral_mappings.target: downstream stress evidence held for later comparison
preconditions: all layer-depth variants exhausted or explicit layer-local blocker cites this receipt
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If a continuation artifact chooses post-stack or bond before the layer matrix is exhausted, mark it out_of_order_under_layer_factory.

extended_constraints: finite PEPS3D K=(V,E,F,C) anchor from the first layer step
torch-native spinor or spinor-derived density carrier where applicable
source-native spinor PEPS3D requirements preserved under controls
literal shell possibility-gradient fields preserved where shell/Axis0/FEP/gravity/flux language is used
A0_raw preserved before Phi0 scalarization where Axis0 language is used
QIT entropy/readouts tied to finite layer-local carrier actions
tool ablation with non-vacuous outcome delta

fixation_breakers: any post-stack/bond/Wolfram next move must prove the layer factory matrix is exhausted or be demoted
any scalar entropy, Axis0, FEP, or PEPS3D label pass must rerun with proxy-erasure controls
every lateral lane must say what it preserves, loses, requires, and what kills it

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first priority-drift or object-preservation failure before adding post-stack, bond, Wolfram, Axis0, flux, FEP, physics, or final-manifold work
loop_contract.stop_condition: all required layer-depth/variant rows are passed, killed, blocked with receipt, resource_blocked, or queued/running with exact continuation; otherwise write the next independent per-layer packet
